svg.title: Jungle River layout
svg.text: JUNGLE RIVER · Jungle River · 108x58 tiles · road 4.5 tiles wide
Lap 251 tiles = 32,069 px · about 38 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 11.3 tiles
Dark channel = deep water (full speed). Pale water = shallows (slower). Patches = banks (slowest; hovercraft skim them).
Buoys mark the tight bends. White chevrons = current. Brown wedge = jump ramp. Orange = fizz/boost. Shore = wall.
Gold dashes = Rapids: 45 tiles, 3.5 wide, instead of 48 tiles of main channel
Gold dashes = Hidden Lagoon: 46 tiles, 4 wide, instead of 51 tiles of main channel
